On this page you can see the Percentage of Speed Lost whilst jumping in the Early , Middle and Late sections of the race together with an Race Average and a Fluency Grade for the overall performance, based on historic winning data at the course. The Consistency figure gives an indication of how each horse’s jumping differed between sections.

Use the icons for a quick explanation of each element on this page or visit our How to use the ATR Sectional Times page for a more detailed guide.
